chunks: So tell the disbelievers: 'You will surely be subdued and driven to Hell: How bad a preparation!'
ai.seo_question: What is the fate of the disbelievers according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed in the context of the Battle of Badr, serves as a divine proclamation of victory for the Muslims and a warning to the Quraysh, emphasizing that their defeat is inevitable and their final abode is Hell. In Shia exegesis, this is often linked to the concept of *Taqiyya* and the ultimate triumph of the Ahl al-Bayt, illustrating how temporary worldly setbacks do not negate the certainty of divine retribution against those who reject the truth.
